errors.evidence: The visible y-axis scale on the chart ranges from 20 to 60, not 0 to 60.

errors.text_span: The NatSQL bar for “Simple” reaches a value of 39.64, while the TA-SQL bar for “Simple” reaches 63.14; for “Moderate”, the NatSQL and TA-SQL bars reach values of 48.60 and 32.32, respectively; for “Challenging”, the NatSQL and TA-SQL bars reach values of 36.11 and 51.35, respectively; and for “Total”, the NatSQL and TA-SQL bars reach values of 36.11 and 56.19, respectively.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly reports the values for most of the bars, mixing up values between categories and models. For example, it states the NatSQL value for 'Simple' is 39.64, but the chart shows it is 60.21. For 'Moderate,' it states the values are 48.60 and 32.32, when they are actually 39.64 and 48.60. For 'Challenging,' it states 36.11 and 51.35, when they are 32.32 and 36.11. For 'Total,' it states the NatSQL value is 36.11, when it is 51.35.
